question: What did Sri Srikantha explain in the auspicious scripture?
premises: His powers are the whole world.
The power-holder is the great lord.
inference: The scripture states that powers are the world and the power-holder is the great lord.
uncertainties: śaktimāṃstu is treated as a supplied token, not split.
plain_english: His powers are the whole world; the power-holder is the great lord. Thus, in the auspicious scripture, Sri Srikantha explained.
